question: Will Abdul El-Sayed win the 2026 Michigan Democratic Primary?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Democratic Primary for United States Senator from Michigan.

If no 2026 Michigan Democratic Senate Primary takes place, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the Michigan Democratic party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

# Research report 1 of 2

I could only use material dated on or before 2026-07-24. Several pages I found were published later, and I left all of them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- I could not fetch any MDP results page, and most direct page fetches were refused by the proxy. Everything below comes from search summaries.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The race is effectively a two-way contest between Abdul El-Sayed and Rep. Haley Stevens.
- 2026-07-05: State Sen. Mallory McMorrow suspended her campaign and endorsed no one. Absentee ballots had already been printed, so her name stays on the ballot. [Michigan Advance](https://michiganadvance.com/2026/07/05/mcmorrow-withdraws-from-u-s-senate-race/), [Local10/AP](https://www.local10.com/news/politics/2026/07/05/democrat-mallory-mcmorrow-suspends-her-michigan-senate-campaign/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-07-16: Time reported that polling after McMorrow's exit had reshaped the race. [Time](https://time.com/article/2026/07/16/new-polling-after-mcmorrow-s-exit-shake-up-michigan-senate-race/)
- 2026-07-16: Electoral-vote.com covered the split polling. [electoral-vote](https://www.electoral-vote.com/evp2026/Items/Jul16-5.html)
- July 10-14 fieldwork: Data for Progress, sponsored by the group American Priorities, had El-Sayed ahead 54% to 41%. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/abdul-el-sayed-haley-stevens-chances-beating-mike-rogers-michigan-polls-12259440)
- July 8-11 fieldwork: Glengariff Group for The Detroit News/WDIV had Stevens ahead 48.2% to 41.4% with 10% undecided (500 likely voters). Among voters who said they would definitely vote for a candidate, it was nearly even: 34.1% Stevens, 33.7% El-Sayed. This was the only independent poll in that stretch. [Detroit Regional Chamber](https://www.detroitchamber.com/stevens-narrowly-leads-el-sayed-in-new-michigan-u-s-senate-poll/), [Cleveland Jewish News](https://www.clevelandjewishnews.com/news/national_news/poll-haley-stevens-holds-seven-point-lead-over-abdul-el-sayed-in-michigan-senate-primary/article_c63dc36d-1c7c-5a7e-aa87-a229e033e478.html)
- 2026-07-08: Tavern Research, sponsored by the El-Sayed campaign (fielded July 6-7), had El-Sayed 41%, Stevens 38%, a statistical tie. [Michigan Advance](https://michiganadvance.com/2026/07/08/new-poll-shows-el-sayed-stevens-statistically-tied-in-michigans-democratic-u-s-senate-primary/)
- July 2026: Jewish Insider reported a poll showing El-Sayed trailing Republican Mike Rogers in the general election, which feeds the electability debate. [Jewish Insider](https://jewishinsider.com/2026/07/michigan-senate-poll-el-sayed-trailing-mike-rogers-tied-haley-stevens/)
- 2026-01-14: Stevens went on the attack against her primary rivals. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/01/14/haley-stevens-michigan-senate-mcmorrow-el-sayed)

## 4. Base rates
- Polls so far: the independent Glengariff poll favors Stevens by about 7, while the sponsored polls (Tavern, Data for Progress) favor El-Sayed by 3 to 13.
- Earlier Glengariff poll (April 17-19): Stevens 25%, El-Sayed 23%, McMorrow 16%, 36% undecided. [Detroit Regional Chamber](https://www.detroitchamber.com/stevens-narrowly-leads-el-sayed-in-new-michigan-u-s-senate-poll/)
- Past result: El-Sayed lost the 2018 Michigan Democratic primary for governor to Gretchen Whitmer by a wide margin. I'm citing that from background knowledge and did not re-verify it.
- I could not find a systematic base rate for progressive challengers against establishment-backed House members in open-seat Senate primaries.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket has a market called "Michigan Democratic Senate Primary Winner" and county-level sub-markets. I could not get the price as of 2026-07-24. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/michigan-democratic-senate-primary-winner)
- Reported prices before the cutoff:
  - El-Sayed reached about 87% on Polymarket in early July. [Action Network](https://www.actionnetwork.com/politics/michigan-democratic-senate-primary-winner-odds-predictions-polymarket)
  - DefiRate reported that markets tightened as Stevens gained, and later that El-Sayed's lead widened after a debate, with Kalshi at 77% (down from a peak near 90%). I could not confirm the exact dates of either article. [DefiRate tighten](https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-tighten-michigan-democratic-senate-primary-stevens-pushes-el-sayed/), [DefiRate debate](https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-lenghten-el-sayed-lead-michigan-senate-primary/)
  - A crypto news piece reported El-Sayed at 73% on a prediction market. Its date is unclear. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/abdul-el-sayed-hits-73-031154241.html)
- Overall, El-Sayed appears to have been the market favorite in July, somewhere in the 70-90% range. I could not get a confirmed price for July 24 itself.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The final debate between Stevens and El-Sayed falls in late July; I could not confirm the exact date. [DefiRate](https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-lenghten-el-sayed-lead-michigan-senate-primary/)
- More independent polls may come out, for example from Emerson or Glengariff.
- Late outside spending, plus whether McMorrow endorses anyone. She has said she will back whoever wins.

# Abdul El-Sayed, 2026 Michigan Democratic Senate primary: research brief (as of 2026-07-24)

## 1. Resolution source
- Mallory McMorrow suspended her campaign, but her name stays on the ballot. [Kalshi News](https://news.kalshi.com/p/michigan-senate-primary-odds-el-sayed-has-a-96-chance-to-be-the-democratic-nominee)
- Republican Mike Rogers is effectively unopposed for his party's nomination. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_United_States_Senate_election_in_Michigan)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. It is now essentially a two-way race between El-Sayed (progressive) and Rep. Haley Stevens (establishment moderate). Reporting on July 24 called it a "tight race." [WTOP/AP](https://wtop.com/government/2026/07/michigan-gov-gretchen-whitmer-endorses-haley-stevens-in-democratic-us-senate-primary/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-24: Gov. Gretchen Whitmer endorsed Stevens, the day before early in-person voting started, and appeared with her and Rep. Jim Clyburn in Detroit. El-Sayed's campaign responded that "the corporate establishment has closed ranks." I don't know whether this came before the 17:16 UTC forecast close. [ClickOnDetroit/AP](https://www.clickondetroit.com/news/politics/2026/07/24/michigan-gov-gretchen-whitmer-endorses-haley-stevens-in-democratic-us-senate-primary/)
- July 2026: AP reports that outside groups have spent heavily for Stevens, including nearly $30M from AIPAC. Another account puts AIPAC-affiliated spending above $50M. [WTOP/AP](https://wtop.com/government/2026/07/michigan-gov-gretchen-whitmer-endorses-haley-stevens-in-democratic-us-senate-primary/), [Ground News](https://ground.news/article/dem-establishment-intensifies-attacks-on-el-sayed-as-new-poll-shows-him-leading-by-double-digits)
- Mid-July 2026: El-Sayed's backers include Bernie Sanders, Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Chris Van Hollen, Maxwell Frost and Stephanie Chang. Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel backed Stevens. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/abdul-el-sayed-chances-winning-michigan-primary-mcmorrow-ends-race-12160118)
- Mid-July 2026 (exact dates unclear): polls disagree.
  - Glengariff Group: Stevens +7.
  - Data for Progress: El-Sayed +13. [DeFi Rate](https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-tighten-michigan-democratic-senate-primary-stevens-pushes-el-sayed/), [Time](https://time.com/article/2026/07/16/new-polling-after-mcmorrow-s-exit-shake-up-michigan-senate-race/)
- 2026-07-08 to 07-11: a Detroit News/WDIV poll had Stevens ahead 48-41 among likely primary voters. [Time](https://time.com/article/2026/07/16/new-polling-after-mcmorrow-s-exit-shake-up-michigan-senate-race/)
- 2026-07-08: a Tavern Research poll (n=2,211) had Stevens 42, El-Sayed 41, 18% unsure, a statistical tie. [Michigan Advance](https://michiganadvance.com/2026/07/08/new-poll-shows-el-sayed-stevens-statistically-tied-in-michigans-democratic-u-s-senate-primary/)
- 2026-07-07: El-Sayed and Stevens debated at WOOD TV in Grand Rapids. [AP via The Daily Review](https://www.thedailyreview.com/ap/washington/michigan-gov-gretchen-whitmer-endorses-haley-stevens-in-democratic-us-senate-primary/article_fed727d2-338f-5db7-8212-45b11008f77e.html)
- 2026-07-05: McMorrow suspended her campaign and endorsed neither candidate. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/abdul-el-sayed-chances-winning-michigan-primary-mcmorrow-ends-race-12160118), [New Republic](https://newrepublic.com/post/212830/michigan-senate-mallory-mcmorrow-exit)
- Late June 2026, with McMorrow still running:
  - Quantus (June 29-30): El-Sayed 41, Stevens 36, McMorrow 8.
  - Tulchin: El-Sayed 46, Stevens 27, McMorrow 17. [NewsNation](https://www.newsnationnow.com/us-news/el-sayed-mcmorrow-michigan-democratic-senate-primary/amp/)

## 4. Base rates
- I found no formal base rate for this kind of matchup.
- Contested open-seat Senate primaries usually go to the candidate leading in the polling average and the markets. Here the polls are split: three July polls favor Stevens or show a tie, and one shows El-Sayed up 13.
- Endorsements from popular governors and heavy outside spending have historically helped establishment candidates. El-Sayed lost the 2018 Michigan Democratic governor primary to Whitmer, though that was a different race and field.
- One structural factor: McMorrow is still on the ballot and could pull a few percent.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Late June to early July: El-Sayed peaked at about 87-90% on prediction markets. [DeFi Rate](https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-tighten-michigan-democratic-senate-primary-stevens-pushes-el-sayed/)
- Mid-July 2026: after the Glengariff and Detroit News polls, Kalshi and Polymarket had El-Sayed in the "mid-60% range." [DeFi Rate](https://defirate.com/news/prediction-markets-tighten-michigan-democratic-senate-primary-stevens-pushes-el-sayed/)
- Kalshi also runs a margin-of-victory market and Lines runs a McMorrow-endorsement market, but I found no reliable July 23-24 snapshot for either. [Kalshi News](https://news.kalshi.com/p/michigan-senate-primary-odds-el-sayed-favored-15-plus), [Lines](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/politics/michigan-democratic-senate-primary-margin-of-victory-20260706180330731)
- I could not find an exact Polymarket or Kalshi price for July 23-24, or any Manifold price. Expert race ratings for the primary also weren't found.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-07-25: early in-person voting begins. [ClickOnDetroit/AP](https://www.clickondetroit.com/news/politics/2026/07/24/michigan-gov-gretchen-whitmer-endorses-haley-stevens-in-democratic-us-senate-primary/)
- 2026-07-27: the final debate airs on FOX 2's "The Pulse." [Fox 2 Detroit](https://www.fox2detroit.com/news/senate-debate-fox2-haley-stevens-abdul-el-sayed-watch)
- More polls are likely in the final week, along with continued outside spending and a possible McMorrow endorsement.

These roughly offset, so I land at about 72%.
